recentItems.description:
Eternally Yours Season 1, Episode 1 ("Pilot") follows Social Security investigator Max as he discovers his girlfriend Emma's family are ancient vampires living in present-day Seattle.

Watch on CBS | Stream on Paramount+ #EternallyYoursCBS
Follow us on Instagram HERE: https://www.instagram.com/cbstv
Follow us on TikTok HERE: https://www.tiktok.com/@cbs
Like us on Facebook HERE: https://www.facebook.com/CBS

ETERNALLY YOURS is a family comedy centered around Charles (Ed Weeks) and Liz (Allegra Edwards) – a vampire couple whose once-passionate romance has devolved into a pulseless marriage after 500 years together. Living in present-day Seattle with their oddball coven, they’ve settled into an eternal rut – until their daughter’s earnest human boyfriend unexpectedly enters their lives and forces them to confront whether their love can survive forever…or if forever is a life sentence.

Key Questions Answered
* How does Social Security investigator Max discover that his girlfriend Emma comes from a family of vampires? 
* Why do 500-year-old vampires Charles and Liz experience marital friction after centuries together? 
* How does Max unintentionally spark a marriage breakdown between coven leaders Charles and Liz? 
* Why are Charles and Liz forced to turn human investigator Max into an undead vampire? 
* What unique supernatural abilities do Emma's half-vampire twin brothers possess? 

Timestamps/Chapters
00:00 - Prologue: Charles Turns Liz into a Vampire
01:35 - Max Meets Emma and Begins Dating
03:00 - Benji Identifies a 150-Year-Old Social Security Anomaly
03:39 - Inside the Coven: Blood Deliveries and Marital Friction
06:14 - Family Dinner: Emma Hides Her Family’s Secret
09:47 - Max Investigates the Residence and Meets Liz and Charles
13:00 - The Coven Contemplates Neutralizing Max
14:15 - Emma Reveals the Vampire Secret to Max
16:27 - Liz Visits Max to Save Emma's Relationship
18:41 - Max Confronts Charles and Stanchly Refuses to Back Down
21:06 - Telekinesis Accident and Turning Max Undead

Step-by-Step Overview
1. Initial Romance: Social Security investigator Max falls for Emma, unaware that her family consists of ancient vampires who have settled in Seattle. 
2. Uncovering the Fraud: Max flags a mysterious Social Security record belonging to coven member Jesse, who has drawn benefits since 1935. 
3. Home Audit: Max visits the coven’s residence to investigate the discrepancy, unknowingly providing unexpected relationship advice to long-married leaders Charles and Liz. 
4. Secrets Exposed: When the coven considers eliminating Max to protect their location, Emma intervenes and reveals her family’s vampire identity to him. 
5. Relationship Intervention: Liz visits Max privately to encourage him to stand up to Charles, leading to a tense showdown over Emma's future. 
6. Supernatural Accident: During a telekinesis exercise, Mort accidentally crushes Max with a heavy marble bust, leaving him near death. 
7. Turning Undead: To save his life, Charles bites Max, turning him into a vampire and permanently binding him to Emma’s eccentric coven.

recentItems.title: Cupertino: Season 1 Episode 1 | Full Episode | Series Premiere: Michael & Olivia | CBS
recentItems.description:
In Cupertino Season 1 Episode 1 ("Michael & Olivia"), two tech startup attorneys team up after being wrongfully terminated to launch a law firm representing individuals taken advantage of by Silicon Valley's elite.

Watch on CBS | Stream on Paramount+ #CupertinoCBS
Follow Cupertino on Instagram HERE: https://www.instagram.com/cupertinocbs
Like Cupertino on Facebook HERE: https://www.facebook.com/cupertinocbs

CUPERTINO is a David vs. Goliath legal drama set in the heart of Silicon Valley. A lawyer (Mike Colter) is cheated out of his stock options by his former employer, a tech start-up. Refusing to back down, he joins forces with another recently fired attorney (Rachel Keller) to represent those taken advantage of by the tech elite and help them fight back in a high-stakes battle against the Goliaths controlling Silicon Valley.

Key Questions Answered
* How do Michael Price and Olivia Siffre get fired from the tech startup S-Talk? 
* What causes Michael and Olivia to join forces and form their own legal practice? 
* How does the AI assistant "Daisy" clone Olivia's voice and personality without permission? 
* How do Michael and Olivia overcome S-Talk's counter-suit and legal delays? 
* What role does Christy Palladino's family play in helping set up the new firm? 

Timestamps/Chapters
00:00 - Michael and Olivia are Fired from S-Talk
04:00 - Venture Capitalists and the AI Prototype "Daisy"
06:12 - Uncovering the Setup and Refusing to Back Down
11:00 - The AI Model "Daisy" Clones Olivia’s Voice and Personality
16:20 - S-Talk Counter-Sues for $18 Million
20:00 - Preliminary Court Hearing Before Judge Onion
24:30 - Securing a Temporary Office with the Help of Christy’s Family
29:00 - Settlement Offer and Arguments Over Publicity Rights
33:00 - Proving S-Talk Stole Olivia’s Personality Data
36:00 - Cross-Examining S-Talk and Exposing the Wrongful Termination
39:00 - S-Talk Settles and Price & Siffre Law Firm Opens

Step-by-Step Overview
1. Wrongful Termination: Co-founder Michael Price and associate Olivia Siffre are abruptly fired from S-Talk under false pretenses of leaking proprietary information to strip their equity. 
2. Uncovering the AI Breach: Olivia discovers that S-Talk used her voice diary recordings to train "Daisy," their main generative AI model, enabling users to generate explicit and unapproved content with her persona. 
3. Filing Lawsuits: Michael and Olivia team up to file dual lawsuits against S-Talk for wrongful termination and violation of publicity rights. 
4. Navigating Retaliation: S-Talk countersues for $18 million in tortious interference and uses delay tactics to stall proceedings ahead of their Series A funding round. 
5. Setting Up Shop: Former assistant Christy Palladino leverages her local family connections to secure a temporary vacant office space for the nascent firm. 
6. Courtroom Victory: By demonstrating in court that Daisy explicitly copied Olivia's personal prayers and habits, the legal team proves personality theft and forces S-Talk into a favorable settlement. 
7. Establishing the Practice: After securing their payout and derailing S-Talk's funding round, Michael and Olivia officially launch "Price & Siffre" to represent tech industry victims.

recentItems.description:
Phil Keoghan of The Amazing Race answers rapid-fire trivia and fan questions while popping confetti balloons in a fun pop quiz. He reveals his favorite game strategies, reflects on 25 years of hosting, and shares a surprising hidden talent.

The Amazing Race airs Wednesdays on CBS and streaming on Paramount+!

Watch on CBS | Stream on Paramount+ #TheAmazingRace

THE AMAZING RACE is a multiple Emmy Award-winning reality series hosted by Emmy Award-nominated host Phil Keoghan, where teams of two embark on a race around the world. At every destination, each team must compete in a series of challenges, some mental and some physical, and only when the tasks are completed will they learn of their next location. Teams that are the farthest behind will gradually be eliminated as the contest progresses, with the first team to arrive at the final destination winning THE AMAZING RACE and the $1 million prize.

Key Questions Answered
* Does Phil Keoghan prefer to U-turn another team or be U-turned? 
* What is Phil Keoghan’s favorite color? 
* How does The Amazing Race host feel about watching early season episodes? 
* What is Phil Keoghan’s most memorable moment after hosting over 400 episodes? 
* What secret hidden talent does Phil Keoghan have that fans don't know about? 

Timestamps/Chapters
0:00 Balloon Pop Quiz Challenge Intro
0:12 Game Strategy: U-Turn Decision
0:29 Favorite Color & Watching Old Episodes
0:49 Phil's Most Memorable Race Moment
1:18 Revealing Phil Keoghan's Hidden Talent

Play-by-Play Overview
Phil Keoghan kicks off the interactive pop quiz by explaining the rules: popping balloons filled with colored confetti determines which color ball he draws to receive a random trivia question.

First up, Phil draws a blue prompt asking whether he would rather U-turn a team or be U-turned. He enthusiastically chooses U-turning another team, declaring that dramatic strategy is what makes for great television.

Next, Phil answers quick personal questions, confirming his favorite color is blue and reflecting on what it feels like to rewatch early The Amazing Race episodes. He jokes that watching old footage serves as a time-lapse of him getting older, moving from the days of standard-definition television to crisp high definition.

Phil then pops another balloon to answer a deep question about his most memorable moment from the franchise. After 25 years, over 400 episodes, almost one million miles traveled, and more than 100 countries visited, he pinpoints Season 1 when he lifted his hand and said "Go!" for the very first time.

Finally, Phil wraps up the pop quiz by revealing a surprising personal secret: he has played the violin since age three, attended music school as a child, and still plays one of the world's most difficult instruments today.

Living in present-day Seattle with their oddball coven, they’ve settled into an eternal rut – until their daughter’s earnest human boyfriend unexpectedly enters their lives and forces them to confront whether their love can survive forever…or if forever is a life sentence.

For over two decades, SURVIVOR has defined reality television, evolving from a bold social experiment into a groundbreaking global phenomenon. Across dozens of unforgettable seasons, castaways have been marooned in remote locations, forced to rely on their wits, adaptability, and resilience to outwit, outplay, and outlast one another.
